description: Intercept GitHub URL fetches (WebFetch and MCP fetch tools) and curl/wget commands, suggest gh CLI instead. PATH shim blocks gh anti-patterns. Clean up cloned repos on session end.

hooks.command: bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?plugin root is unset, refusing to run hooks from the working directory}/hooks/persist-session-id.sh"
bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?plugin root is unset, refusing to run hooks from the working directory}/hooks/setup-shims.sh"
bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?plugin root is unset, refusing to run hooks from the working directory}/hooks/intercept-github-fetch.sh"
bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?plugin root is unset, refusing to run hooks from the working directory}/hooks/intercept-github-curl.sh"
bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?plugin root is unset, refusing to run hooks from the working directory}/hooks/cleanup-clones.sh"
